video_title: Pat Bev says that Rudy is the SECOND best defensive player EVER 👀🤯

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley defends Rudy Gobert as a top-tier NBA defender
quotes.excerpt: I really still believe in Rudy Gobert being a top three, top four defender in the NBA.
quotes.quote: I believe in the coaching in Minnesota. I believe in Finchy. He was my assistant when I was with the Rockets. I was under him when I was with Minnesota. I really still believe in Rudy Gobert being a top three, top four defender in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley ranks Rudy Gobert as an all-time great defender
quotes.excerpt: He was the best defensive player to ever play the game besides Wemby.
quotes.quote: He was the best defensive player to ever play the game besides Wemby. Before Wemby came, he was the best defensive player to ever be in the game of basketball. His percentages are, and I'm going off numbers. I know you guys, I don't know if you guys ever.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley highlights Rudy Gobert's unique defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: His rim protection is something that we've never ever seen in the game of basketball.
quotes.quote: His rim protection is something that we've never ever seen in the game of basketball. His defensive rebounding, mind you, that's a part of defense also. His defensive rebounding is something that we've never seen. For you to play the Utah Jazz back when he played, for you to play the Minnesota Timberwolves while he's on the court, your offensive schemes have to change. You have to change your whole offense only because of him, not because of anything else.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson questions Patrick Beverley's defensive rankings
quotes.excerpt: You say Rudy's better than Anthony Davis defensively?
quotes.quote: You say Rudy's better than Anthony Davis defensively?

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley asserts Rudy Gobert's defensive superiority over Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: Yes, I mean the numbers say it. It's not close.
quotes.quote: Yes, I mean the numbers say it. It's not close. He wouldn't be, you just don't up and get defensive player of the year. You just don't. They don't hand those out. And I'm a defensive guy, trust me. It was hard for me making some defensive teams. I don't think you guys understand what he does.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva lists recent Defensive Player of the Year winners
quotes.excerpt: Marcus Smart is the only guard in the last how many years to get defensive player of the year?
quotes.quote: Marcus Smart is the only guard in the last how many years to get defensive player of the year? Gary Payton, Tony Allen, you ain't got one, Avery Bradley ain't got one, Jrue Holiday ain't got one. Come on, bro. That's all I'm saying.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley explains Rudy Gobert's defensive impact on perimeter players
quotes.excerpt: Wemby can guard on the perimeter, too.
quotes.quote: Wemby can guard on the perimeter, too. I've never seen Rudy Gobert guard on the perimeter. He's more mobile, but he's a more evolved version of Rudy Gobert.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley claims Rudy Gobert is a better defender than many stars
quotes.excerpt: In every gym, defensively, we'll take Rudy Gobert out of every guy you just named.
quotes.quote: In every gym, defensively, we'll take Rudy Gobert out of every guy you just named. Every guy. You talk about Michael Jordan, Dennis Rodman, Bruce Bowen, Kawhi Leonard, Kawhi Leonard. Shit, Paul George can guard. There's a plethora of guys that we can talk about.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton explains Rudy Gobert's impact on opponent shooting
quotes.excerpt: Rudy changes people's shots. He gets that, I mean, don't show up on the stat sheet.
quotes.quote: Rudy changes people's shots. He gets that, I mean, don't show up on the stat sheet. Some of the shit that he does to the shots, Anthony Davis does that. He changes shots.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley compares Rudy Gobert and Anthony Davis defensively
quotes.excerpt: You're telling me the difference between Anthony Davis and Rudy Gobert, you'd take Rudy Gobert over Anthony Davis defensively?
quotes.quote: You're telling me the difference between Anthony Davis and Rudy Gobert, you'd take Rudy Gobert over Anthony Davis defensively?

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley confirms his preference for Rudy Gobert's defense
quotes.excerpt: Expeditiously.
quotes.quote: Expeditiously.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley explains why Rudy Gobert is difficult to play against
quotes.excerpt: You come off pick and roll against Rudy Gobert, you don't see the rim.
quotes.quote: You come off pick and roll against Rudy Gobert, you don't see the rim. Can you pull up the Luka clip and see if he saw the rim against the Minnesota Timberwolves?

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley argues Rudy Gobert's health is a key factor
quotes.excerpt: You take Rudy Gobert off any one of those teams that he's been on, that's they've made the playoffs.
quotes.quote: You take Rudy Gobert off any one of those teams that he's been on, that's they've made the playoffs year after year after year after year. His ability to stay healthy, people don't talk about that.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley argues defensive greatness is tied to health
quotes.excerpt: Now we're determining guys being best defensive players because they're healthy.
quotes.quote: Now we're determining guys being best defensive players because they're healthy. Yes, you have to. How you the best defensive player if you're not available? Guess what, the one that has not been healthy got a ring.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley questions Anthony Davis's defensive status
quotes.excerpt: Does he have a ring? Man, all right. If you are the best, if we're talking about the best, you need to be able to be on the floor at all times.
quotes.quote: Does he have a ring? Man, all right. If you are the best, if we're talking about the best, you need to be able to be on the floor at all times. If you're able to not, you just talked about you just talked about. You don't like the bubble ring? You don't respect the bubble ring? I respect it. I think it was hard to get.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva distinguishes between regular season and playoff awards
quotes.excerpt: The defensive player of the year, the MVPs, all these awards are season awards.
quotes.quote: The defensive player of the year, the MVPs, all these awards are season awards. We're talking about what guys do in the playoffs. That's not how you judge or earn defensive player of the year and the MVPs.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley expresses his belief in coaching
quotes.excerpt: I believe in coaching. I think LaMelo provides pace. I think it moves Ant to his natural position.
quotes.quote: I believe in coaching. I think LaMelo provides pace. I think it moves Ant to his natural position. I think he was out of position this season. I think he played a little bit too much on the ball. I think he's really good come off pin downs, coming off stagger screens, stuff like that.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva discusses Anthony Edwards's growth
quotes.excerpt: I feel like last year we all talked about we want him to play meaningful basketball.
quotes.quote: I feel like last year we all talked about we want him to play meaningful basketball because at first I just thought he played a little bit one leg step back, which he still do that shit, and it works. But I think him playing meaningful basketball last year, clutch time, playoffs, let me believe that okay, he's taking that step to go somewhere and play with somebody like Ant and help them get over that hump.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva discusses Minnesota's need for a point guard
quotes.excerpt: They're going to miss Naz Reid. I will say that. I think they can go get somebody to fill that.
quotes.quote: They're going to miss Naz Reid. I will say that. I think they can go get somebody to fill that. I think their point guard was the biggest thing they missed last year. They had a point guard last year. I think things will be a whole lot different.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley analyzes Minnesota's roster dynamics
quotes.excerpt: I think you kind of relied on maybe the big. They tried to let Julius be the point guard.
quotes.quote: I think you kind of relied on maybe the big. They tried to let Julius be the point guard, not really playmaker, not really point guard. And now you got a true general who led, like I keep saying, he led, Conk Nipple, Brandon Miller, Miles Bridges, and Diabate. Now with no disrespect for those guys, now he has that on steroids with the Anthony Edwards, Iyo Dosunmu, Jaden McDaniels, and Rudy Gobert. That's a different level.
